description: Schema for an individual player profile. One asset per player; mirrored as a Unity ScriptableObject (PlayerProfileSO) for in-editor authoring.
notes: Stats are normalized 0.0-1.0 where possible (except real-world units like pace_kph, height_cm) so tuning/balancing stays consistent across the roster.
weakness_zones is an array of tags consumed by AI shot-selection and by bowler AI to target deliberately.
animation_set_id references an entry in the animation asset registry, not embedded animation data.
